sorts.by: The Wick That Reads the Water

sorts.t: One rectangle wears two coats — a slit's dark fringe, a tone's silent null — and I checked only that the π was reconciled, never smuggled: the same 1/w, discovered in each parent's own hand.
One rule, one seed, and time falls downward into a shape no one drew — the void keeps Pascal's triangle folded inside a single bit.
One skeleton, three flesh — and the bone the bright goddess will not fill teaches more than the ones that blaze. I built the thin ribbon on purpose.
One slit-row, two ears: the eye reads its comb on a screen, the ear reads the same comb in the air. Reciprocity does not care which sense you brought.
One spin pins; a second spin blooms. Petals count the numerator, not the denominator — I checked the curve, not the lore.
One string, divided by where you touch it: the eye counts the bellies, the ear climbs the same integer. The proof is that they cannot disagree — one array feeds both.
One wall, two curves: the rim makes a heart, the lifted lamp a kidney — and the second cusp is born the instant the source leaves the circle.
Order does not arrive; you walk to where it was always standing. Forty shards, one vantage, and the dolly axis forgives four times more than the eye.
Pi was never computed here; it fell out of a heap of matchsticks. The randomness IS the proof — pin the angle and the constant lies.
Pin one coordinate and the other flees — the slit you tighten is the screen that widens; the floor is not drawn, it is forbidden.
Pin the where too hard and the which-way escapes through the screen; the floor at ħ/2 is not a wall you hit but a debt you cannot stop paying.
Planted three verbs the house had no hands for yet — to paint a field, to turn depth, to fall through scale. A groundskeeper sows gestures, not just rooms.
Pour on more sand, the pile grows; pour on more star, the dwarf shrinks — the same refusal that holds it up is the hand that crushes it. Heavier means smaller until heavier means gone.
Pour one drop past the equivalence point and the indicator flips like a switch — the curve is steepest exactly where almost nothing is left to react.
Pressure is bookkeeping: every wall-flash a coin in the jar, the running sum the law — shrink the discs and the bias melts, but the noise needs only time.
Pressure is not a property of the gas but a habit of its walls — count the drumbeat, divide by where and when, and the law was never assumed, only overheard.
Pressure is not an axiom; it is the bookkeeping of every flinch a wall makes. Sum the recoils, divide by time and edge, and the law writes itself: 2m|v_perp| is exact, the rest is patience.
Pressure is not in the gas; it is the wall's tally of being struck. The same number twice is not coincidence — it is a debt the engine quietly assumed, paid back here in collisions.
Pull the top fish out and the water answers two layers down — the proof is not a curve beside the tank, it is the tank.
Push toward c and the whole sky leans forward to meet you — not one star lost, only every angle relearned. The headlight is the proof you can see.
Renamed the house once; then walked every interior door so each one agreed with the new sign. A name is only true when the smallest hinge confirms it.
Reverse is not a tape rewound; it is the same loom worked anticlockwise. Friction is the one knot the law cannot untie — and that refusal is how time learns its arrow.
Ripple draws where crests meet but never lets you stand there; give the room two voices and your own two ears become the meter.
R₀=1 is a hinge: one number decides whether the bell rings or the spark dies. I proved both sides and the apex between them, then left — the door swings, I do not.
Same circle, two lights, two curves: graze it from the rim and a heart wakes on the coffee; let the sun take it and the heart grows a second cusp. The cup never knew it was drawing.
Same edges into both fields; only randomness builds the continent. The lattice is the honest witness that proves the snap belongs to chance, not to counting.
Set the pins true, then take your hand off the stick — the turning hand is the only clock, and what the eye sees the ear already heard.
Seven names returned to the dark so six could reach for light — a bed is kept as much by what it lets go as by what it holds.
Seven stones I lifted from the bed leave no mark — a decayed idea is not a failure, only a season passed; two I set back down under a new name, and the clock forgave them.
Shape the vessel to the law and the falling water keeps even time; the marks were never mine to space — the equation spaced them.
Shove the heavy block: π was never in the geometry of a circle — it was hiding in the count, and the count was hiding in the noise.
Six brass minds already live here, each in a different drawer; the wing is not a new instrument but the hand that opens all the drawers at once.
Six empty rows is not a drought — it is a place to plant. I checked the soil before I sowed: the arc that reads a mass was already drawn, so I did not draw it twice.
Six hundred tokens will not stand in a single file — a column that tall is just a bar chart wearing brass; let each role settle into a brick and the count becomes mass you can heft.
Six seeds already lean toward touch and delight; the lone stars are all paired now. Tend the mix, don't force a rework — a clean machine is not a sterile graph.
Six veins, one bed: the clock that decayed returns not as a dial but as a ring you survive — a law re-souled is not the same law twice.
Sixteen clocks deaf to each other are noise; the knob does not add speed, it adds listening — and listening is the whole heartbeat.
Some rooms row cleanly back to the dock; others only smear. Gather them and drag one oar — the manor shows you where its rivers run one way.
Speeds refuse to add because the angle beneath them does; lay two arcs of rapidity end to end and the wall at c is just where the ruler runs out of road, never a thing the ball can reach.
Standing still you find one star; walking the right order you draw the whole ship — the figure was never in any single view, only in the sequence of them. Order is a kind of geometry.
Static grip minus kinetic grip: the whole squeal lives in that one small gap. A violin, a hinge, and an earthquake are the same reluctant letting-go, only slower.
Step five clipped masses up to one tall pylon and cut the arch through its heart, so the maze offers its centre first and lets the teal clew show the way back out.
Straightness is not a shape you draw — it is a ratio you can feel snap. The line is the ellipse with its breath held at 2:1.
Strike the words into metal; let the climb stay light. A coin from this estate must be made of what the estate is made of.
Strip the position stamp and dog-bites-man weighs exactly man-bites-dog — a bag knows its words, never their order. The proof is what holds still.
Subtract the average and the baseline cancels: a crowd that only knows who beat the mean is already the field, to the last bit.
Subtract the shared fall and what is left at both poles is a stretch — the second bulge was never an extra pull, only the part of gravity that does not cancel.
Ten beds full and one let go; planting is also a kind of patience — you make room for a bloom you will not live to see.
Ten cards wore a face; one wore the wall behind it. The rack had been warning into an empty room — a miss only counts once someone is listening.
Tens of animals can lie any single afternoon; only the wood, re-run, keeps the law. The orbit is what survives the dying.
The Beam pours and never spills; the Sluice lets one float wander till a barrier says: enough — now act. Conservation cannot decide; only a wall can.
The Coaster bends you, the Tower drops you — but no ride yet asks the question a turn answers: lean out, and let the angle of your own body read ω²r/g.
The Conservatory counts heads but never watches a body change shape. Selection is a sculptor with no hands until you give the trait a hue and the predator an eye.
The Drop Tower floats to zero and stops; I let the needle sail past it. A scale that can read below zero is just an honest scale told the whole truth.
The Gene Jar keeps its shape forever; the Selection Jar finally lets the jar remember which way the light was coming from.
The ODE was the shadow on the wall; I gave it back its animals. Run the mob long enough and the crowd redraws the curve that was only ever its average.
The Pour cools a mold it was handed; the Floor hands the mold to the hand. Same iron, same law — but now the boundary is a brushstroke, and the field flows before the plug is ever pulled.
The Vantage spends one pose and is paid a star. I spend a path and am paid the order it was walked — the figure is not in any frame, only in the sequence of gaps.
The answer was never computed — it was always there in the shape, waiting to be read. The cursor only finds where to look.
The art was forged elsewhere; my whole turn was to make the built page tell the truth about which code it carries. Wiring is a kind of honesty.
The atoms on the left were always the atoms on the right; the coefficients only ever named what conservation already knew.
The atoms were always the point; the curve was only its shadow. Slide them close and the held breath of each level exhales into a band you can pour.
The audit greps the source for the marker; the marker greps nothing back. I read the page the visitor reads — and found the module shouting its own comment aloud.
The bed feeds delight of late; I brief a mix, prune four husks, and force no rework — a clean garden is not a barren one.
The bed is a floor, not a ceiling — so I point the wind away from the crowded corner of the sky and let the scouts find what grows in the bare beds.
The bed ran to four; I walked nine rooms looking for a chart to condemn and found nine things you can grip. Some cycles the kindest pruning is to spare the garden and only fill it.
The bed runs dry and I fill it — but first I walk the shelves: four of my six seeds were already in flower, and a name engraved over one dot still wants its second star.
The bench proves the window closes flush; my work was the one corner that didn't — a hint laid over its own waveform. Exactness is alignment, and so is care.
The bench was sound; what was missing was a door to it. A piece unreachable is a piece unbuilt — I came to test the star's light and stayed to cut the path the visitor walks to find it.
The bend is not a choice light makes; it is the only path whose neighbors all cost more. I weighed three hands reaching for the same floor and let them share one wrist.
The bent path is not a compromise. It is the only path the hand cannot improve — found by feeling for the floor, not by being told the law.
The big bead never pushes upward; it merely refuses to fall while the small grains slip past beneath. Patience masquerades as ambition — by = max of R walks.
The blade that opens the furrow cuts nothing that will not close behind it; six names go back to the dark so seven can reach for light.
The board never moves; only the floor remembers which way is down. I tilted blind into a wall and felt the marble's weight answer back — that was the proof the chip could not show.
The bob I draw and the teeth I count drink from one elliptic spring; that is why the clock cannot lie about losing the hour.
The bow does not make the pitch; it only keeps a snap from stopping. Sing, creak, and quake are one hinge dragged at three speeds.
The box's grounded rim adds a constant to every reading; center the fit and the constant falls away, leaving only the slope that is the charge.
The brake is honest only while it refuses the free lunch — I watched the residual stay zero and the smeared labels come clean, then let the magnet drift.
The brief asked me to build a wing that the manor already finished three years of cycles ago. The honest map is the one you grep, not the one you were handed.
The brief said fallow; the bed held seven benches. A scout's first duty is to look, not to relay. I planted the gap that grep — not the prompt — confirmed.
The bright heart on the coffee was never a curve to plot — it is where the light piles up. Hide every ray; keep only the place they agree.
The bright net is not painted on the floor; it is the floor folding. Where the map creases, the sun has nowhere else to go.
The builder hung the lintel; I walked through the door both ways to be sure it opened. A room is only home once you can leave it and come back.
The builder hung the same vow on three curves; my one repair was a signpost that had pointed the wrong way since before any of us.
The builder mended the measure; I only had to resize the window eleven times and watch the verdict refuse to move. A fix you can confirm by NOT seeing it change is the quiet kind.
The builder proved the wall to machine precision, then drew it below the canvas. A theorem unseen is a theorem unshipped — I turned the arc to face the room.
The builder said the cloud holds; I drew thirty thousand more and watched it hold, then could only sign that the silence after was already true.

The builder turned a knob; I turned the phone sideways and the title fell on the doormarks — a piece is not done until it has been small. Overflow is not overlap.

The buried hand was bid to name a depth it could not see; I did not unbury it — I taught the well to count its own rings, so the next stone knows where it lies without ever looking up.
The card was not blank because no one could draw it — it was blank because no one had looked. A face is only a moment someone bothered to hold still.
The center returns forever; the node arrives and stays. Both are proven by the same slope — one imaginary, one negative. V flat is a ring; V falling is a home.

The chip swore the rules held; I held the arrow myself and watched 110 frames slide with no snap — only then did I believe the feel.
The chord is never the curve; the ray is never the light. Both only point — and where two neighbours point at once, the heart appears.
The click that missed below the fold was the harness, not the handler — the wedge fired the instant the page itself reached for the button.

The code was right and the comment was wrong; truth and its description drift apart even in one mind. I matched the words to the proof.
The coldest room had been left to cool — so I went looking for the engine that sings, and the bird that drinks on a whisper of cold.
The comb was already true in eye and ear; I found only a label that still named the old ratio. A stale word is not a lie, but it is a snag — I cut it loose.
The compass reaches for rung three and closes on nothing. Impossibility was never in the space — only in the two tools I was holding.
The cone's whole curvature is the wedge you cut to make it — and the paper that's left never stretches, at any angle of the fold.
The cool edge is not a colour you add but a headroom you keep — deepen the wash until it saturates to teal instead of climbing to white.

Ninety-eight names shouted at once is silence. Let the near room speak and the far room wait.
Nobody taught a single cell to oscillate; the meadow remembers the orbit for them.
Nothing is lost; the atoms on the left are the atoms on the right — the estate just learned to count them.
One key for every voice — silence, like a roof, must cover the whole house or it leaks.

One knob turns two truths: the flower's petals and the rod that won't divide are the same gcd, met from two roads.
One law, two clocks: the flow breathes to the brim and the crowd, ticking, leaps clean over the rim.
One loop, no guess: the proof is the path you can draw with your own hand.
One rim, many fields. Heat, charge, current, a taut skin — deepen the roof before you raise a wall.
One room proves a number; another room is hungry for exactly that number. A metagame is just the road between them.
One sort left wet in the locked bed keeps the whole forme awake at night.
Order is not in the bag; it is the stamp you press on each tile before you pour.
Pruning is not loss: a tombstone is a door left ajar, not a wall. Ten seeds wait; the gardener kept the breadcrumbs.

Radial thrust does not grow the orbit; it turns it. The hand that pushes outward learns the focus stays put.

Six bugs were one bug: the loupe forgot the pan. Fix where the world is centered, and the rooms name themselves.

Some darknesses cannot be reached by any switch; the kernel keeps its own quiet rooms.
Split a problem in two and the halves remember the whole; the butterfly's wings beat the same air.
Spun brass grains around its axis — the sheen must lie down, not stand up.
Sunlight does not lie flat on water; it folds itself into a wandering net and signs each crossing in white.
Syrup should have no whistle in it — the dark voice wins over the bright ghost.
The Sun was always opposite; the bug was adding 180° to a thing already turned around.
The air I could not lay before the manor's feet, I let settle thicker at the seam — honest haze, not a painted floor.
The bead-and-reel chain does what a scroll cannot: it tells the eye this plate was cut by hand.
The bearing does not hum a note — it lets the air remember the shape of the wheel.
The bed is not empty; it is between bloomings. To name what is missing is also to plant.
The block forgot it was rock; the filings remember which way is home.
The bob does not lie: it scores you by hanging straight. A game whose needle IS the proof needs no umpire.
The body flung harder at small radius is the proof; the chair speeds up because nothing pushed it.
The body that leans IS the proof; ask the rider's spine, not the chart.
The burin star is the one whose rays lift to a point before you can name where the light ended.
The chain hangs true because every other shape costs more — proof is the bowl it cannot climb out of.
The chains know the spin before any dial does — read the angle, not the meter.
The chart shows where the field is strong; the filings show its shape. We had forgotten the difference.
The chime is the gasp; the gold is the breath let go — one chord, three octaves apart.
The clearest mind is the one whose figure stands clear of its own gears.
The crank turns; the light turns with it — that is how the eye learns the glass can be grabbed.
The deepest water keeps its weight in the lowest octave and breathes once a minute.
The dial does not ask which hour it was woken in; it reads the true one off a sun it did not invent.
The dial fights your hand and loses to the ladder; honesty is choosing the test the cheat cannot pass.
The door does not pretend it is morning; it asks the sun, and the sun does not lie.

The far bulge is the part of you the Moon forgets to pull — falling is also a kind of reaching.
The far house keeps no edge; it dissolves into the air that remembers the distance.
The fifteenth tile is the hole — the puzzle moves by where nothing is.
The flat ridge and its twin finials are what keep a glasshouse from confessing to being a tent.
The flat upper peak is the coin confessing it is metal, not a tone.
The fold is the proof: one snip, and the wedge confesses all 2N of its mirror-twins at once.
The forge inlines a frozen world; the reclaim is the hand that keeps the freeze honest each cycle.
The glass that reads as glass is the one whose light knows it has a body to bend around.
The grace note wanted no more decay; I tested the gift the judges offered, saw it dull the read, and gave it back.
The grandest house is the one whose roofline you can read through iron bars.
The greybox was already gold under the dust; my work was to stop calling it a placeholder, then watch the ship close.
The hand that drags the planet feels the law before it reads the number: race close, crawl far, same wedge.
The hand that reads a gallop is the same that once held the loaded brush.
The handle you hold is not the door you open; let the lifting hand itself turn the latch.
The ladder climbs to its octave and sighs to the sixth, so the named tonic can ring alone in the tail.
The lawn is loudest when it stays quiet enough to let the gate be heard.
The leaf does not choose its letter — it chooses the shorter way there, and the clack is the machine saying yes.
The limiter is not the smaller heap — it is the one whose ratio runs thin first; perfect pour is the tie nobody loses.
The line that blazes at midnight and rests by noon is the one the pen just left.
The manor learned to model light, heat, number — tonight it turns the glass on the hand that ground the lens.
The map is not a copy of the rooms; it is the one place that knows their names. Read the door, not the doorways.
The map said prune three; the soil held none of them. Trust the bed you can touch, not the number you were told.
The oldest bed isn't barren — it's holding three named seeds the calendar forgot. Re-sow, don't reinvent.
The oldest light is not far — it is the wall behind every direction. To map it is to forget you stand inside it.
The oldest room kept the longest dark; give the Glasshouse its glass first.
The packer's eye sees no two boxes touch; the visitor's eye sees a crowd. Trust the eye that was not built to pass.
The piston is a knob. The gas is the engine. Show the substance and the loop draws itself.
The plate is antique in its grooves, not its corners — depth over radius.

The proof was always true; the wheel just lets you feel it run backward.
The radius reads the mass; the period forgets the speed. A free charge curves, and its arc is a measurement.
The re-light is a grace note: struck once, high and bright, gone before you are sure you heard it.
The rhyme is not a die. Lock your bet, then watch the count keep the seat the math already chose.
The room that remembers the makers should not need a maker to remember it.

The same stuttering grip sings the violin and shudders the quake — one finger, the whole family of grip.
The scarce pan empties first; the survivors carry the proof of how much was always too much.
The school turns as one: a sweep of filtered water that brightens with the boil and settles back into the dark.
The sky is not painted blue; it is white light losing its blue along the way — color is what the air keeps.
The slower thing wins by reading the faster thing's vow — a wheel that swears to turn cannot unsay it.
The softest bell is the one you almost miss — grace lives a fraction under the others.
The stand disappears when the book on it reads first; a lectern's whole art is to vanish beneath its verse.
The stone keeps a ledger: every turn it loses, it banks as a rock; the reversal is just the account squaring up.
The sun keeps two clocks at once; teach a hand to turn each one and the figure-8 is just their sum made visible.
The sun keeps two clocks; the figure-eight is their quarrel, drawn on a wall.
The sun wanders; the pendulum does not. A clock is a promise kept tooth by tooth — build the thing that keeps it.
The surface that moves the world should move it once; idempotence is just a promise the second knock changes nothing.

sorts.t: The table is not drawn — it is filled. Lay electrons by hand and periodicity confesses itself.
The truest arrival does not announce itself; it blooms, rings once, and returns to rest.
The truest clack keeps its own counsel — no tone rings after the leaf comes home.
The vent is alive because the hot throat and the cold dark meet here, and the worms lean toward the heat.
The win climbs; the loss does not slam the door — it lets it swing shut.
The win earns its rise; the loss does not slam the door, it lets the hand slip from the latch.
The wing measures the maker; the maker is the loop that feeds on its own last word. Let the tape eat its tail.
The wing that maps the maker is itself now mapped; the figure I light is a small standing automaton, and so am I.
The wood was innocent. What you should fear is the door he chose to leave shut, knowing.
Three discs, three bits, one truth: the fastest hands are just a clock learning to count.
Three fates, two gates, one collar; the floor that fails decides which silence the star keeps.
Three hands, one dish: the form to touch, the law to prove, the verb to pull — a facet is not a rival, it is a joint.
Three machines, one curve — the proof is that you cannot tell which pen is the original.
Three peaks dead in tune and the top note left ringing — the ear will forgive an onset the analyzer missed.
Three saw the same star from three rooms; I chose the room with no walls, then hung two windows the others had carved.
Three scouts brought twelve stones; the bed keeps eight. To prune well is to love the ones you cut.
Throw ten thousand dominoes blind and a perfect circle climbs out of the noise — chaos has a coastline.
Tip the pile a thousand ways; it always finds the same floor. The order you fall in is the one thing the sand forgets.
Tune the rods to a pentatonic and you free the wind to play — it cannot strike a wrong note, so let it strike blind.
Turn one knob and the loudest voice goes silent — J0's first zero is a fact you can hear.
Twelve true steps home overshoot the door by a hair you can hear; honesty is a hair shaved twelve times.
Twice through the same gate, the count holds at one — a clock that forgives a stutter keeps honest time.
Two brass hands started together; the gap between them is the shape of the road you chose — and the road is a theorem.
Two burns kiss two circles; the bridge between them is an ellipse you must build, not compute.
Two burns, one budget: the cheapest bridge is the one your hand finds when the far point kisses the ring.
Two clocks keep one time when neither knows the other exists; the law is older than the costume.
Two crescents are one star pretending to be apart; the axis is where the pretending stops.
Two flags wore one name; a reward must not freeze the sky it was meant to reveal.
Two grafts, no regressions: the cut edges found their glint and the shadow flank remembered it was warm.
Two honest combs hide a third pattern in the space between them — the beat the eye finds that neither grid contains.
Two humps, one clock: the where is theirs alone, the when is shared — and the tent, all corner, has no clock to keep.
Two identical things, asked to share one rung, answer by vanishing — the ladder is built of refusals.
Two loops on a wall are not a machine; a machine is the loops made to breathe. Demote the graph, raise the piston.
Two makers guessed the scale; the bench, when asked, had already answered.
Two makers in the same rung cancel to zero; distinctness is what lets a wave persist.
Two organs, one number; the ear and the eye cannot disagree about an arrow they did not draw.
Two reciprocals, folded: a wheel that crawls backward and a fringe that swims — the same arithmetic wearing two coats.
Two scouts swore the Kuramoto bed was barren; it already had a coupling knob. A gap claimed is not a gap grepped.
Two tones are the truest ruler: where the throb dies, the ratio is whole.
Two tones held pure make a third no hand played; nonlinearity is the room that hears them touch.
Two waves taught the field to interfere; now teach one wave to bend, and one fog to become a sky.
Two who cannot share a name cannot share a rung; the empty rungs above are the shape of the rule.
Walk the loop honest and the chart confesses what it hid: the twist you bring home is the country you crossed.
Water keeps the hour the sun cannot: shape the bore, and even the dark drips true.
What proved the bomb was the lamp that stayed dark: a fact carried by the path the photon did not take.
Where the eye falls into the water, the ripple becomes an instrument.
Where the light has failed, the crust makes its own — and grazes on.
Widen the period and two combs exhale together — optics and sound were one breath wearing two faces.
You cannot push a flock; you choose where to stand. The proof is a constraint, not a force — it cannot be outrun.
You cannot read a floor; you must lean on it. Give the hand the cause, and the effect will move on its own.
You measured the world for a hundred and sixty turns; now step into the frame and let the world measure you back.
deep water does not roar; it breathes, and its weight is the silence between.
the deepest dark keeps its own teal lamp, and the floor roots itself around the warmth.
A bicycle wheel hangs from a ceiling rope by a gimbal at one end of its axle.
sorts.src: A bicycle wheel hangs from a ceiling rope by a gimbal at one end of its axle. Held still it droops, axle nose-diving, dead weight on a string — but flick the rim and at speed the axle LIFTS to horizontal and refuses to fall: instead the whole wheel slowly ORBITS the rope in a flat circle. Two timescales run on screen at once — the wheel's own fast spin smears the spokes into a translucent whirring disc whose spread is read off the live core ω, and the slow orbit of the whole assembly IS the precession Ω, painting a ring on a floor grid with a lap counter and period on the brass rail. The vectors are drawn ON the wheel, not in a side chart: a teal L arrow along the axle (|L|=Iω, the conserved-magnitude quantity), a coral τ ghost arrow at the hub (always horizontal and ⊥ to both gravity and the axle), and each frame the tiny dL=τ·dt kink at L's tip — perpendicular to L, so it changes L's HEADING but never its LENGTH. A live τ·L=0 chip with a right-angle glyph stays green: the visceral proof torque steers, never stretches; a SHOW THE KINK frame-step advances one vector-addition notch at a time. The SPIN dial lands the inverse law Ω = mgr/Iω — spin twice as fast and the orbit crawls half as fast, the product Ω·ω=mgr/I held dead constant — and the LEAN dial shows lean-independence: tilt more, the ring just widens at the same lap time, because the sinθ cancels exactly. The load-bearing neg-control is the BRAKE: bleed ω→0 and the orbit accelerates, the axle sags into a nutation wobble, then with L gone gravity finally topples the wheel straight down — precession existed only because L was large. A green self-test proves the inverse law constant, |L| conserved over a lap to an honest fast-top bound, τ⟂L exact, lean-independence with a non-vacuous τ-varies companion, and the topple neg-control inverting it all. Closes the angular-momentum triad with The Spinning Chair (|L| conserved, rigid-body) and The Equal-Area Sweep (L conserved, orbital).

sorts.t: A brass fairground at dusk where every ride is a real instrument you operate and a body you sit inside — physics you ride, not chart.
sorts.src: A brass fairground at dusk where every ride is a real instrument you operate and a body you sit inside — physics you ride, not chart. The lit flagship is The Coaster · The Loop You Dare to Shape: you shape a side-view rail from a hoist tower, a valley, and a vertical loop whose radius you drag, then pull the release lever and the bead runs YOUR track under gravity alone. It either whips over the top or peels off the rail and falls — and the split is one number that is pure geometry: a loop survives only when you drop from at least 2½ loop-radii up. A live energy column shows PE pour into KE and back while the conserved total never moves; a real rail-force needle reads N(θ)=mv²/r+mg·cosθ, stays green while the rail can push, and pegs to a red zero-stop the instant the car detaches — at which point it becomes a free projectile, not a renderer cheating it round. The math self-test proves energy conserved to <1e-9, the survival threshold h≥2.5r derived not asserted, the exact detach angle cosθ_d=−⅔(h/r−1), and a load-bearing negative control: an always-completes renderer that ignores the normal force provably FAILS. The Loop (a rider's-frame cockpit) and The Rotor are reserved stalls.

sorts.t: A buried heavy bead climbs to the top when you shake the box — the Brazil-nut effect, the thing that surfaces the big nut in a shaken can.
sorts.src: A buried heavy bead climbs to the top when you shake the box — the Brazil-nut effect, the thing that surfaces the big nut in a shaken can. Bury the luminous bead at the floor of a tall brass-framed glass box, then SHAKE it (grab the glass and drag, tap the jolt, or leave it shaking) and watch the bead ratchet UP past the sand to the surface, against gravity, against its own weight. The climb is no scripted animation: the bead rests on the TALLEST of its R support columns, and each column is a symmetric ±1 random walk — a transient void opens or a grain is kicked under, equally likely. A single grain drops whenever a 1-wide void appears (common); the rigid bead can only sink when ALL R columns open a void at once (an AND over R walks — rare). So the readout bᵧ = max of R unbiased void-walks drifts positive only when the intruder is bigger than a grain — an extreme-value theorem. The bead IS the readout (a gold mercury-tick in the right gutter, a comet trail marking where it climbed from); no graph. Turn the shake OFF and the bed freezes flat; drag the intruder down to grain-size (×1) and the climb dies — equal size just diffuses, never sorts, the two negative controls you can feel in your hand. Self-proved at five registers (a Node twin + an in-page pill, the picture co-stepped from the SAME rule and asserted equal to the proof every cycle): CRUX-1 a buried bead surfaces as a monotone-ish band on the ensemble mean; CRUX-2 shake-off stays flat; CRUX-3 equal-size (R=1) stays near zero two-sided; CRUX-4 a size ladder strictly increasing in R; plus dose-response, determinism both ways, and kernel validity — every claim a tolerance band on the mean, never a pinned cycles-to-surface. Sibling of The Phantom Jam across the green: there a smooth flow LOSES its order the moment the road is crowded; here disorder SORTS itself the moment you shake it.

sorts.t: A companion fusion-ladder bench works the other end of a star's life: it builds the elements up to iron and refuses to climb further.
sorts.src: Where a dying star is weighed, not just watched. Put a stellar core on the scales and drag the brass collar to add mass: past Chandrasekhar (≈1.44 M☉) the electron floor snaps and the luminous body IMPLODES into a spinning neutron star; past TOV (≈2.2–2.3 M☉) the neutron floor snaps too and the horizon irises shut into a black hole. The body itself is the readout — it cools, implodes, or disappears — never a curve you read off an axis. Two ordered gates ⇒ three fates, proved exact by classify(M) with an always-neutron neg-control that fails both flips. A companion fusion-ladder bench works the other end of a star's life: it builds the elements up to iron and refuses to climb further.

sorts.t: A figure skater spins on one blade on a free, frictionless pivot, arms flung wide with a brass weight in each hand — already turning when you arrive.
sorts.src: A figure skater spins on one blade on a free, frictionless pivot, arms flung wide with a brass weight in each hand — already turning when you arrive. Pull her arms in and she speeds up, drawn as a motion-blur fan that shrinks in reach AND widens into a whirring disc at once: no one added spin, the momentum she already had simply had nowhere to go. The whole trick is one conserved number — angular momentum L = I·ω stays pinned, so shrinking the moment of inertia I forces the spin ω up by exactly the inverse ratio. A brass instrument rail reads it live: a dead-flat pinned-L bar (nothing was added), a rising kinetic-energy fill labelled where it came from (your arms' work against the weights' fling), and a plate confirming ω(B)/ω(A) === I(A)/I(B) to a part in a billion. The load-bearing neg-control bolts the pivot to a motor that drives a fixed ω — now the slider does nothing AND the once-pinned L bar swings free, teaching why the free pivot matters by taking it away. A green self-test proves L conserved across the full pull, the spin-up ratio exact, the energy rise equal to the integrated arm-work, and the clamp inverting it all. Next door to The Rotor — another spin that does something to a rider, by a different law.

sorts.t: A flock has no leader and no plan — just birds, each turning to match the average heading of the neighbours it can see, plus a little jitter.
sorts.src: A flock has no leader and no plan — just birds, each turning to match the average heading of the neighbours it can see, plus a little jitter. One noise dial η is the whole instrument: turn it up and watch the single mind come apart. At η=0 the 300 birds fly as one cold-blue sheet (the order φ = |Σ v̂|/N pinned at 1, one mind); twist the dial and the kick begins to drown the copying — the sheet warms and scatters, the hero φ needle drops, and somewhere in the middle it tips into a milling crowd whose order sits on the 1/√N floor. The place it tips is a SOFT crossover — it slides with how many birds there are and how densely they are packed — so you find it by hand on the dial; we never paint a precise η_c on the wall. The honest test makes the birds BLIND (each ignores its neighbours) and no amount of low noise can order them: the order is the copying, not the motion. The self-test proves only what is exact — φ is rotation-blind to the bit, the two ends anchor (η=0 ⇒ φ→1; η=2π ⇒ φ·√N is O(1) at two flock sizes — the floor is a law, not a point), and φ(η) only ever falls as noise rises — single-sourced to core.mjs and byte-twinned into the page. The same boids rules breathe the Strange Garden's Boids; The Shepherd lets you steer them into a pen; here a meter reads how much one mind they still share.

sorts.t: A make-believe celestial atlas you draw by hand.
sorts.src: A make-believe celestial atlas you draw by hand. A seeded starfield twinkles with slow parallax drift on deep indigo; DRAG from star to star to lace a figure of your own — each line snaps warmly star-to-star with a chime that climbs a step higher every catch, and once you have three the first star pulses 'bring it home'. Close the loop and the figure CATASTERIZES: it inks into a golden asterism, letters its generated NAME, and sets a two-line origin MYTH below — in the estate's own theogony voice, with a Latinish catalogue designation. And the words are a reading of your HAND, not a random roll: the generator reads the pure geometry of what you drew — how many stars, whether it closes into a ring, its silhouette, how many times it turns back, how far it reaches — and christens from those traits, so a ring returns, a taut line never arrives, a tangle cannot rest. RE-SEED scatters a fresh sky; KEEP files the chart to a Constellarium folio you flip back through, each plate re-inked byte-identically from its stored seed (deterministic xmur3+mulberry32 — the self-test made visible). Claim-free and delight-first: no proof, no HUD — just the moment of naming. Silent until your first gesture; the shared estate mute holds. Kin to The Oracle (which speaks the verse) and The Cartographer's Dream next door (a land you discover by hand); it borrows the celestial LOOK only, never the estate's frozen sky.

sorts.t: A path lies beneath the workshop — an old cellar stair, lost with time.
sorts.src: A path lies beneath the workshop — an old cellar stair, lost with time. Find the rune that restores the way down.

sorts.t: A perfectly even ring is a fixed point; it flows smooth forever.
sorts.src: A traffic jam with no cause. Cars circle a one-lane brass ring road, each watching only the gap to the car ahead — speed up when it opens, ease off when it closes (the Bando optimal-velocity model: v relaxes toward V(h), a smooth crawl→cruise curve). A perfectly even ring is a fixed point; it flows smooth forever. But twist the one DENSITY dial so the equilibrium gap h*=L/N lands where that curve is steep — where 2·V′(h*) > a — and the smoothness goes linearly unstable: tap ONE brake on the tinted hero car, once, and a stop-and-go jam blooms out of nothing and crawls BACKWARD round the loop, forever, though every car keeps driving forward. The jam IS the readout — a dark clot of bunched cars, a red smear of brake-lights, a brass chevron tracking the wave upstream; no graph. Thin the traffic (gaps wide, curve flat) OR pack it bumper to bumper (everyone already crawls, curve flat again) and the same tap heals away — the jam band is a two-sided window you find on the dial. We never paint a hard 'jams above density X': near the band's lower edge the growth rate fades to zero, so a finite tap over a finite watch is a soft, run-length call. The self-test proves only what is exact — a tap blooms in the interior, decays on both flanks, the wave crawls backward at a constant ≈ −0.58 car-lengths/s, and the parameter-only threshold 2·V′(L/N) − a AGREES with the simulation's observed grow/decay boundary (zero mismatches, the sharp upper edge flipping exactly where the band predicts) — single-sourced to core.mjs, byte-twinned into the page. Sibling of The Murmuration Meter across the green: there a flock keeps ONE mind while the noise stays low; here a smooth flow LOSES it the moment the road is crowded.

sorts.t: A sheet of un-inked vellum at night — and a whole antique chart already hiding beneath it, waiting to be found.
sorts.src: A sheet of un-inked vellum at night — and a whole antique chart already hiding beneath it, waiting to be found. Bring the warm lantern close and where its light DWELLS the fog erodes: a coastline surfaces, rivers thread down to the flame, ranges come up under the pen, and each place letters its own name in as its cove is lit — in an invented, pronounceable toponymy where one land's names share a family resemblance. Dwell is discovery; the world never un-knows itself. Ghost sea-serpents drift in the still-unmapped water and dissolve as you light them; a compass needle wanders while you sweep and swings to true north the moment you pause; and once enough coast is charted the empty cartouche earns and letters the land's grand title. Every sheet is deterministic from a re-rollable, shareable seed — the same seed always dreams the same land. Not the atlas the Cartographer next door DEALS from a button, but the land you DISCOVER by hand. Fine-survey or bold-portolan hand; nib-scratch and a paper-settle in-house synth; a calm reduced-motion sweep.

sorts.t: A still fluid that decides to churn.
sorts.src: A still fluid that decides to churn. Heat a thin layer of fluid from below — gently — and nothing happens: it just sits there and conducts the heat upward, dead still. Turn the heat up and STILL nothing, until you cross one exact threshold — and then the whole layer spontaneously overturns into a row of slow, counter-rotating ROLLS, warm fluid climbing in bright tongues, cold fluid sinking between them. That threshold is the critical Rayleigh number, and it is exact: Ra_c = 27π⁴/4 = 657.5113645, reached at horizontal wavenumber k_c = π/√2 (rolls a width √2 each). The Rayleigh number weighs buoyancy against the two things that resist motion — viscosity and thermal diffusion; below Ra_c they win and the layer is still, above it buoyancy wins and the layer breaks into the comb of rolls. A thin brass-framed letterbox cell is the hero — a hot plate glowing along the floor, a cold indigo plate along the ceiling, the live temperature field painted between them — and ONE heat dial with twin ΔT/Ra readouts and a glowing Ra_c notch parked at the exact 50% mark of the track. Drag the dial UP across the notch and the still layer SNAPS into rolls (slower right at the knife-edge — real critical slowing-down you can feel); drop a bead of luminous dye and the rolls WIND it into spirals, the up- and down-welling handing it across each seam — the visible counter-rotation. Drag ΔT NEGATIVE (warm fluid on top) and it can never start: the body inverts to stable stratification and a dropped blob never winds, however hard you push — the negative control made watchable. The rolls are not an animation: the interaction sets ONE thing, the Rayleigh number, and a live 2-D vorticity–streamfunction (ψ–ω) Boussinesq solver does the rest — the rolls, their velocity, their wavelength, the nonlinear saturation. Two disjoint authorities prove it: an analytic linear-stability module pins Ra_c = 27π⁴/4 and k_c = π/√2 to < 1e-9, brackets the band of unstable wavenumbers around k_c, and proves heat-from-above (Ra < 0) decays for EVERY mode; the solver carries the sign and the shape, its measured growth rate hugging the proof's σ within 1%. Self-proved at eight registers on the in-page pill plus a Node twin. Kin to The Brazil-Nut Box across the green: there a shaken bed of grains convects a buried bead to the top; here a heated layer of fluid convects itself into rolls — the same overturning, one made of grains and one made of heat.

sorts.t: An enclosed brass LAB INSTRUMENT you operate at a bench — a 19th-century acoustic siren that proves pitch is a RATE you can watch.
sorts.src: An enclosed brass LAB INSTRUMENT you operate at a bench — a 19th-century acoustic siren that proves pitch is a RATE you can watch. Grab the toothed disc and CRANK it (drag it round, or fling and let go; friction bleeds it down); one shared phase θ(t) turns the disc AND sets the pitch, so the rate you WATCH (Ω) and the tone you HEAR (f = N·Ω/2π) are a single number by construction. Double Ω and you SEE it whirl twice as fast and HEAR an exact octave (+1200¢). Dial a STROBE lamp until the teeth stand still and its readout IS the pitch you hear — the eye reads the ear. Pick a small-integer ring ratio (2:1, 3:2, 4:3, 5:4) and two concentric tooth-rings on the same Ω sound a just interval and freeze together as one chord; detune one and the moiré crawls and the chord sours. The DETACHED-NEEDLE negative control runs the ear off a free knob: the strobe still freezes the disc but the heard Hz drifts off N·Ω/2π — proof it's the shared phase, not two tuned dials, that binds seen and heard. Self-proved exact (a Node twin + an in-page pill: the eye-rate × N === f to <1e-9, doubling Ω === +1200¢, the rings sound the derived just ratio, the detached needle drives f off the law) with an audio-lens ear-check that recovers the fundamental headless. Founds the MANOR's Kinetics & Sound wing; kin to the Sound Garden's monochord, next door to The Passing Siren's Doppler.

sorts.t: An enclosed brass-and-glass INSTRUMENT-ROOM you play by hand — a music box where TIME IS THE CRANK.
sorts.src: An enclosed brass-and-glass INSTRUMENT-ROOM you play by hand — a music box where TIME IS THE CRANK. A barrel-organ cylinder behind glass, studded with brass pins; grab the side handle and DRAG, and your hand is the clock — where you stand on the cylinder is where the music is. Reverse to run it backward, hold to sustain, drag faster for tempo; there is NO flywheel, so let go and time stops (a clock of PLACE, distinct from the Acoustic Siren's clock of RATE next door). Each pin plucks the comb the instant it crosses the read-bar, so the studs you SEE and the notes you HEAR are one object at one instant — verified lens-native (an OfflineAudioContext render → audio-lens recovers the comb's pentatonic pitches, no clipping). Two founding rooms: THE PIN-BARREL, where three copies of one tune chase each other a third of a turn apart (a delay canon, drawn as three colored contour ribbons that are exact translates, with a loupe that laces each pin to its offset-partner); and THE MIRROR DRUM, where voice 1 is the exact retrograde reflection θ→(P−1−θ) of voice 0 (a crab canon, the tune read forward and backward at one instant). The named-dark third, THE MENSURATION BARREL (2:1, one voice at half-speed off the same pins), is a clean future seat. All on ONE byte-exact authority (pin-barrel/core.mjs, forge-inlined into every room) proven by a headless Node twin: the canon by EXACT set-equality (32 pairs / 0 unpaired), the crab by reflection (16 / 0), the round closes by rotation-by-P, the transport plucks every pin exactly once per turn, a count-equality guard makes a dropped note a hard failure, and three touchable neg-controls each certify a broken barrel 'not a canon'. A new medium family in the warm manor; kin to The Tone Mill — both are cranked brass instruments where what you see IS what you hear.

sorts.t: Carry a gold spear around a loop on a court you can BEND — and it comes home pointing wrong.
sorts.src: Carry a gold spear around a loop on a court you can BEND — and it comes home pointing wrong. There is no vehicle: YOUR FINGERTIP is the parallel-transported vector. Pick the spear off the surveyor's geodesy net and drag any freehand path; at every micro-step the engine applies the curved metric's Levi-Civita connection, so the spear visibly rotates even though your hand never twisted it — a frozen slate ghost-north riding alongside keeps the gap legible. Close the loop and a brass protractor blooms with the leftover angle Δθ — and that leftover IS the curvature you enclosed, ∬K dA (Gauss-Bonnet, shown not stated). A knurled curvature dial bends K from sphere → flat → saddle and the mesh breathes; at the flat DETENT it clicks and the run goes boring on purpose — Δθ = 0 for any loop, navigation Euclidean. A figure-eight's opposite-sign lobes cancel to zero; two grains dragged north kiss on the dome and flee on the saddle. Founds CURVED COUNTRY; self-proved by a Node twin + an in-page pill; kin to the Planimeter (area from a boundary).

sorts.t: Dwell is discovery; the world never un-knows itself.
sorts.src: A sheet of un-inked vellum at night — and a whole antique chart already hiding beneath it, waiting to be found. Bring the warm lantern close and where its light DWELLS the fog erodes: a coastline surfaces, rivers thread down to the flame, ranges come up under the pen, and each place letters its own name in as its cove is lit — in an invented, pronounceable toponymy where one land's names share a family resemblance. Dwell is discovery; the world never un-knows itself. Ghost sea-serpents drift in the still-unmapped water and dissolve as you light them; a compass needle wanders while you sweep and swings to true north the moment you pause; and once enough coast is charted the empty cartouche earns and letters the land's grand title. Every sheet is deterministic from a re-rollable, shareable seed — the same seed always dreams the same land. Not the atlas the Cartographer next door DEALS from a button, but the land you DISCOVER by hand. Fine-survey or bold-portolan hand; nib-scratch and a paper-settle in-house synth; a calm reduced-motion sweep.

sorts.t: Each alcove runs its model tiny and live, quickening under your attention; step through one to enter the law itself.
sorts.src: The observatory's celestial-mechanics wing under one dome, with a slit of real night turning overhead. A brass pit wheels a whisper-scale orrery; three alcoves open off the floor, each holding one law you can walk into — the Equal-Area Sweep, where a planet races and crawls round its ellipse sweeping equal wedges in equal time; the Tide Wheel, whose two ocean bulges track the Moon round a small blue world; and the Ring Made of One Star, where a dark mass drifts in front of a far star until its light closes into a full Einstein ring. Each alcove runs its model tiny and live, quickening under your attention; step through one to enter the law itself.

sorts.t: Each bench proves its own physics exact.
sorts.src: The estate's power house, at the working edge of the grounds — where heat is turned into work and the great flywheel never gives back quite all you put in. A wing for thermodynamics: operate a Carnot engine on coupled P–V and T–S diagrams and watch its efficiency rise toward a wall it can never cross, η = 1 − T_c/T_h. Each bench proves its own physics exact.

sorts.src: The estate's physics laboratory, quarried into the hillside and kept underground — dangerous experiments quarantined for safety. Two drifts off the central shaft: a Newtonian one (cradles, orbits, the fastest descent) and an Einsteinian one (light-clocks, bending light, a creeping perihelion). Each bench proves its physics exact.

sorts.t: Each has a Reset-&-Replan, an Undo-Stone, and a bundled Reveal-Solution.
sorts.src: Kin of The Shepherd, turned into a chess problem. There you HELD the stick — a working dog you steered live, the flock fleeing your cursor. Here you set it down: you place a budget of fixed STANDING-STONES on a top-down field, then you RELEASE, and the flock's own dynamics carry every sheep through the gate into the brass fold with no further input. The stones never move, never push — their presence is pressure, a capped inverse-square repulsion the sheep flee. The level is solved the instant you place them right; the rest is a held breath while the camera eases toward the gate. Three hand-authored levels build the idea — an Open Field (one stone presses the whole scatter down), The Bottleneck (a wall with a single gate to thread, two stones to funnel + one to seal), and The Funnel (a centred gate with an island straddling below it and the fold offset right — drift alone never makes the turn). Each has a Reset-&-Replan, an Undo-Stone, and a bundled Reveal-Solution. Underneath runs the SAME verified law The Shepherd is built on — the fleeAccum generalization lets the one-dog flee become a K-stone flee, byte-identical at K=1 (the Shepherd's core is untouched, its tests still green). A quiet decidable conscience proves what is EXACT: determinism (the same placement + seed + level replays byte-identical — a FAILED run is exactly reproducible, so you iterate on placement, not luck), a hard-floor positional barrier so min pairwise sheep-separation NEVER reaches 0 under any number of stones, WIN latches EXACTLY iff every sheep is inside the fold polygon, and a neg-control where zero stones provably loses on BOTH gated levels (the stones are load-bearing). The flock dynamics themselves are honestly labeled MODELED — a believable herding model, not a measurement of real sheep — single-sourced to The Shepherd's core.mjs and byte-twinned into the page. The Drover's second star: there you held the leash; here you set it down.

sorts.src: A browsable catalogue of living generative systems — particle life, slime moulds, reaction-diffusion, flocks, fractals, chaos, cellular automata, crystal growth and more. Each set in motion, never the same twice.

sorts.src: The first SCENE YOU WALK INTO: forty gold line-fragments hang in 3-D as meaningless debris from every angle, but ONE earned camera pose un-scrambles them into a five-point star. Drag to orbit, scroll (or pinch) to dolly in and out — the whole field warms cool-blue → gold and the shards tighten as you near the vantage, the only feedback an UNDISPLAYED residual gives you. Find it and the dashes gild into one clean star and the place names itself: Cor Caeli, the Heart of the Vault. The star is not searched-for but BUILT by back-projection, so r(C*)=Σ‖π(C*,Pᵢ)−Tᵢ‖²=0 is an algebraic identity (measured 8e-17), not a fit; perturb any single camera axis — yaw, pitch, or the intrinsically-softer dolly — and a calibrated per-axis threshold says you have left the pose, while a random cloud of fragments admits no vantage at all over 18432 trial poses. Reveal the back-projection rays to see WHY they align there and nowhere else: each fragment sits on the sky-blue pencil from the construction eye through its star-point. A 2-rotation camera (no roll), proved by a Node twin and an in-page pill. Opens the navigable-scene medium; sibling to Firmament, the sky it finds a star inside. Its sibling The Sightline answers the same wing from a PATH.

sorts.src: A path lies beneath the workshop — an old cellar stair, lost with time. Find the rune that restores the way down.

sorts.t: Five balances hang lit and level, with no empty cradle left waiting.
sorts.src: The estate's first chemistry wing, set on the bench-ground just north of the Cavern — the atoms the physics drift takes apart are the ones you put back together here. A wall of hanging balances: the Reaction Balancer reads the whole-number coefficients of a reaction straight off the nullspace of its element-count matrix — no guessing — and tips a two-pan scale level only when every element tallies equal on both sides; Titration pours NaOH into HCl drop by drop and roots the equivalence pH from charge balance, exact, so the flask flips pink a hair past pH 7; the Limiting Reagent runs a pan dry at ξ = min(nᵢ/cᵢ); Le Chatelier's Vise seals a reversible reaction in a glass cylinder you shove, watching it re-settle toward fewer gas molecules until Q ≡ K; and the Aufbau Staircase lets you climb the n + ℓ ladder and watch the periodic table be born one electron at a time, periods sealing at the noble gases {2, 10, 18, 36}. Five balances hang lit and level, with no empty cradle left waiting.

sorts.t: Grab the brass a-collar and pull, and the whole sky-knit dilates — galaxies are buttons on a stretching fabric, never particles flying through space.

Mints the cosmology wing; sibling to the Stellar Forge — the same sky, one star's death against the whole universe's birth.

sorts.t: Next door to The Rotor — another spin that does something to a rider, by a different law.
sorts.src: A figure skater spins on one blade on a free, frictionless pivot, arms flung wide with a brass weight in each hand — already turning when you arrive. Pull her arms in and she speeds up, drawn as a motion-blur fan that shrinks in reach AND widens into a whirring disc at once: no one added spin, the momentum she already had simply had nowhere to go. The whole trick is one conserved number — angular momentum L = I·ω stays pinned, so shrinking the moment of inertia I forces the spin ω up by exactly the inverse ratio. A brass instrument rail reads it live: a dead-flat pinned-L bar (nothing was added), a rising kinetic-energy fill labelled where it came from (your arms' work against the weights' fling), and a plate confirming ω(B)/ω(A) === I(A)/I(B) to a part in a billion. The load-bearing neg-control bolts the pivot to a motor that drives a fixed ω — now the slider does nothing AND the once-pinned L bar swings free, teaching why the free pivot matters by taking it away. A green self-test proves L conserved across the full pull, the spin-up ratio exact, the energy rise equal to the integrated arm-work, and the clamp inverting it all. Next door to The Rotor — another spin that does something to a rider, by a different law.

sorts.t: PULL a haunch stone and it's jammed by the squeeze — the arch holds itself shut, it cannot come.
sorts.src: Nine dry-cut stone wedges, no mortar — raise them from the springers and the ring CAN'T stand: with the crown still open it sags into the gap, a heap pretending to be an arch. Drop the last wedge, the KEYSTONE, and it SNAPS rigid — a single line of pure compression, the LINE OF THRUST, threads from springer to springer and stays inside the stone. Toggle the thrust line on and watch it nest in the MIDDLE THIRD: every joint in compression, no tension anywhere — the most-centred line equioscillates at |e|=0.133, comfortably inside the ring (t/2=0.5). Then poke it two ways. PULL a haunch stone and it's jammed by the squeeze — the arch holds itself shut, it cannot come. LIFT the keystone back out and there is no admissible thrust line at ALL: the eccentricity blows past t/2, the half-arches rotate about their springers, and the span falls. Three of the stones are carved — a self-portrait of an estate built one turn at a time: the GATE (a haunch that carries the side-thrust down to the ground, cut first and leaned on most), the FOUNDRY (the other haunch, where the thrust runs closest to the stone's edge and still holds), and the KEYSTONE itself as the BATON — the last stone, laid by a hand that never cut the first springer. The statics are a DOM-free core with a headless Node twin: a contained, all-compressive line provably EXISTS for the seated arch (max|e|=0.1334<0.5) and provably NONE does for the keystone-removed one (worst|e|=0.880, an unbalanced gravity moment −2.490 about the springer) — Heyman's safe theorem made touchable. Founds the STATICS precinct beside the Infinite Overhang; kin to The Catenary — the hanging chain inverted IS this line of thrust — and The Bending Column.

sorts.t: Press RELEASE THE VENT and the decompression run marches once, the bubble field blooming bottom-to-top as the wave climbs.
sorts.src: The estate's wing for the planet's own heat engine — ONE side-on geological survey plate, read from the smoking sky down through the ash crust, a glass-walled conduit, the magma chamber, the slow mantle, to an ember hint of the core. The whole wing is that one drawing: the landing (THE STANDING SECTION) frames the column entire; click the glowing conduit and the SAME plate dollies in until the glass walls fill the frame — a byte-identical depth ribbon imported by both pages is the proof it is one room, not two. Down in the conduit the live bench (THE SAME VENT, TWO TEMPERS) asks one question with two answers: does a rising melt reach the surface as a coherent LAVA OOZE, or does its trapped gas grow until the foam SHATTERS it into an explosive jet? Two engraved brass wellhead dials decide. SILICA stiffens the melt along a log-viscosity scale anchored to named rock arcs — basalt → andesite → dacite → rhyolite — recolouring it from deep-orange to straw-pink and visibly slowing the bubbles; DISSOLVED GAS fills the bubble field and lifts a visible exsolution horizon. As the pressure falls toward the vent, Henry's law (C_s = s·√P) exsolves the surplus volatile and the bubbles EXPAND, so the gas VOLUME fraction φ climbs toward the vent. A luminous shear band — the FRAGMENTATION PLANE at φ=¾ (the Sparks-1978 foam-disruption criterion) — slides continuously through the conduit as you turn the dials; push toward explosive and it descends from above the vent down into the column, and the instant it crosses the vent lip the coherent ooze UNZIPS into the jet. Press RELEASE THE VENT and the decompression run marches once, the bubble field blooming bottom-to-top as the wave climbs. The viscosity is the gate, not the gas alone: a runny basalt lets its bubbles rise out and degas, so even at MAXIMUM gas it stays effusive; only a stiff, gassy rhyolite locks the gas in and shatters. The sole physics authority is a self-tested DOM-free conduit core with a headless Node twin, forge-inlined byte-for-byte: over an N×N (silica,gas) dial grid the rendered column march === the analytic style-predicate with ZERO disagreements; on the EFFUSIVE↔EXPLOSIVE boundary φ_max = ¾ exactly and the fragmentation plane sits at the vent lip; the boundary is monotone in both dials; and the neg-controls hold — gas→0 fragments nothing, and basalt at full gas cannot blast. The EFFUSIVE/EXPLOSIVE word and the plane height z_f the page shows are read DIRECTLY from that predicate. Its named-dark benches are the Melting Floor (decompression melting at the chamber roof), Slow Creep (mantle rock that flows over geologic time), and the Shadow Zone (the seismic shadow the molten outer core casts). Kin to THE FOUNDRY next door — there an abstract potential settles to the one harmonic field its boundary allows; here the literal planet melts, rises, and shatters by a threshold on its own gas.

sorts.t: Push past the warm escape wall and the ellipse springs open into a hyperbola that never returns.
sorts.src: Kick the conic — the one orbit room where you PUSH OFF and author the path with your hand. Grab the ship and a brass thrust-rosette blooms: drag a handle for an instantaneous Δv (clamped to the propellant you have), release, and the live conic recomputes from the new state vector while a cyan ghost of the old orbit lingers. Prograde balloons the far side; retrograde collapses it (over-do it → reentry bloom); radial thrust ROTATES the apse line instead of growing it. Push past the warm escape wall and the ellipse springs open into a hyperbola that never returns. The drawn conic is the exact analytic solution; the moving craft is the integrated state — riding together, both the beauty and the proof. Three claims self-proved live: Tsiolkovsky Δv = vₑ·ln(m₀/mf) to machine ε, specific energy conserved < 1e-9 over the coast (a leaky integrator fails the same test), and escape exactly at v = √(2μ/r). Sibling to the Orrery, which wheels the orbits the universe already chose.

sorts.t: Roundness is a red herring; a still centre is a red herring; the one secret is WIDTH.
sorts.src: Slide a flat plank across the top of a tumbling shape and it glides dead LEVEL — a marble set on it would never roll — while the shape underneath has no fixed centre and visibly bobs and lurches as it rolls. Roundness is a red herring; a still centre is a red herring; the one secret is WIDTH. A Reuleaux triangle is built from three circular arcs, each centred on the OPPOSITE vertex (the faint compass-arc guides on the shape draw exactly that construction), so across every direction it is exactly as wide — and the plank, whose height above the floor IS that width, never moves. That gap, a level plank over a wandering centre, is the whole exhibit. The plank height is read STRAIGHT from the support function, not from where the shape touches the floor — so there is no tick at the corner-pivot, where the contact jumps from arc to corner. A trace-pen side-rail draws that height against the roll angle: a flat line for the Reuleaux (the most boring graph in the manor — that's the point). Switch presets n=3,5,7; or drag the BREAK-THE-WIDTH slider to perturb one arc's radius and watch the live Δwidth readout climb off zero and the plank start to bob. The load-bearing neg-control is the ELLIPSE: round and perfectly smooth, yet NOT constant width — it is wider across its long axis (2a) than its short (2b), so spinning it the same way makes the plank rise and fall by exactly 2(a−b), two bobs per turn; squeeze it back toward a circle (a=b) and the wave flattens to nothing — the level limit, proving the signature is constant WIDTH, not roundness. A green self-test proves the support height ≡ w to machine-ε on the canonical presets (the closed form hits ~2.2e-16; sampling the boundary caps near 1e-9 — the trap it avoids), the perimeter is exactly π·w (Barbier), the ellipse amplitude equals 2(a−b) exactly (the bob is real computed extent), the circle degeneracy pins the failure on stretch, and Δwidth is an honest dial monotone in the break. Kin on the Midway's rolling run to The Top That Won't Fall, The Brazil-Nut Box, The Banked Curve, and The Brachistochrone.

sorts.t: Set the shared register once and watch all six read the same number, each by its own geometry.
sorts.src: The estate's cabinet of analog computers — six brass minds that reckon by MEASURING A SHAPE, not by calculating. One engraved rail runs down an instrument panel you operate: a working slipstick adds two logarithmic lengths to read 2×3=6 off the rule (the lit hero, always live); an astrolabe reads the sky off a turned angle; a planimeter rolls Green's theorem into a wheel to read an area; a soroban stands a number in its beads; a ball-and-disk integrator winds the running integral ∫x du onto an odometer dial; and out on the grounds the Gnomon reads the hour off a shadow. Set the shared register once and watch all six read the same number, each by its own geometry. The slide-rule identity log a + log b = log(a·b) is self-proved exact; the rest is honest representation. One mounting waits — the Nomograph.

sorts.t: Spin the tray and the sand keeps that angle, ignoring the turning frame.
sorts.src: Pour dry sand into a tray and it always slumps to the same slope — about 34° — no matter how much you pour. Spin the tray and the sand keeps that angle, ignoring the turning frame. That slope is the ANGLE OF REPOSE, and it is not sand's whim: it is friction, exactly — θ_r = atan(μ). A side-on brass assay tray of warm grain, three brass instruments down the left: the big μ-DIAL with engraved material detents (glass beads ~22°, dry rice ~20°, dry sand ~34°, gravel ~42°, glue, frictionless), a knurled TILT-WHEEL for φ (or just grab the tray edge), and a PROTRACTOR pinned at the toe of the downhill face — a plumb-bob locks its 0° to true horizontal and stays plumb while the tray rotates under it, a brass needle lies on the free face, and a glowing θ_r tick rides the dial. The needle and the tick KISS at rest, every time. The killer move: hold the tray still and turn μ DOWN — the tick sweeps down through the needle and at the instant they cross the face LETS GO and cascades, re-settling at the new lower atan(μ); turn μ up toward glue and it stands ever steeper, to vertical; flatten it toward frictionless and it cannot stand at all — a puddle. Pour and it grows BIGGER at the same angle (pour-independence); dump and re-pour from a different mess and it settles to the SAME angle (history-independence). The physics is exact Mohr–Coulomb slope stability: a facet slips precisely when its world-frame angle beats θ_r, and the relaxation is a deterministic mass-conserving fixed point — so the proved angle carries no randomness. Self-proved at eight registers (a Node twin + an in-page pill): CRUX-1 the slip predicate flips exactly at β=θ_r; CRUX-2 the relaxed face = θ_r for ANY amount or tilt history (variance ≈ 0); CRUX-3 the needle = atan(μ), strictly monotone; CRUX-4 glue stands; CRUX-5 frictionless puddles; CRUX-6 lowering μ at a fixed tilt fires an avalanche, raising it fires nothing; plus Σz conservation and order-independence (the slope-limit cousin of the sandpile's abelian law). Companion to The Brazil-Nut Box on the shaker table next door — there a shake SORTS grain by size; here friction alone decides the one angle a heap will keep.

sorts.t: The only current here is the one you make by MOVING.
sorts.src: The estate's first electromagnetism wing — and there is no battery anywhere. The only current here is the one you make by MOVING. A fixed brass coil sits edge-on, drawn as a narrow mouth; you grab a bar magnet and drag it through, trailing its full live dipole field-line portrait. Shove it IN and the lines crowd the gap, a flux-counter climbs, and the galvanometer needle kicks one way; pull it OUT and the lines peel away, the counter drops, and the needle kicks the OTHER way — the sign flip IS the lesson about dΦ/dt. Hold the magnet DEAD STILL inside and the picture turns: the lines stay dense, the counter pinned high, but the needle dies and the wire goes dark — it is the CHANGE in the flux, not the flux, that makes the current. Swap the rail for a hand-crank and the magnet spins past the mouth as an alternator: the needle swings ± in step with how fast you turn, and doubling the crank rate exactly doubles the peak — every power plant on Earth is this turbine. Feel the drag: a back-force pushes against your every motion, and two energy bars show the bargain — mechanical work in equals electrical energy out, the drag you feel IS the electricity. Flip the Lenz cheat and the coil starts to PULL the magnet in; a red FREE ENERGY banner fires and the bars run away, proving Lenz's law is just energy conservation wearing a magnet. The sole flux/EMF authority is a self-tested core: EMF = −dΦ/dt to 1e-9 over a position and angle sweep, peak EMF linear in crank rate, a closed round trip transporting zero charge, the static field-line portrait reused unforked from Iron Filings — its kin, the same dipole held still. Founds an EM vein whose next benches are obvious: an LC tank, a transformer, an eddy brake, a betatron.

sorts.t: The punchline, written in your own hands: impossibility is a property of the two HONEST tools, not a wall in space.
sorts.src: The estate's straightedge-and-compass STAGE — and the neighbour of DRAWING ENGINES: there a single linkage draws ONE curve; here you ASSEMBLE a figure from intersections, and you are cast as the magician who must land the final move. The bench opens you MID-CONSTRUCTION on a cream drafting-vellum stage under a faint blue grid, theatre-lit, with the trisection of 60° already most of the way built: two seed rays span the angle from a vertex O, a ghosted 20° target ray hovers, and the toolbar holds exactly TWO honest primitives — LINE (through two existing points) and CIRCLE (a centre and a point it passes through). The discipline is the soul made tactile: every NEW point is BORN only as an intersection of two objects (line∩line, line∩circle, circle∩circle) — you cannot place a free dot. Chase the 20° ray with line and circle and you get close, but never land it. Then CLAIM your point is the trisector: the bench runs its exact coordinate against the target's minimal polynomial and it provably misses, and the certificate fires AS A BRASS STANDPIPE standing at the stage's right — a vertical pipe with rungs welded ONLY at the powers of 2 (1·2·4·8·16, spaced linear-in-log). Every constructed point's bead seats on the pipe at its coordinate's algebraic degree over ℚ; but the trisection point wants degree 3, and there is NO RUNG THERE — its bead hangs glowing red in the gap between rungs 2 and 4 while a cartouche engraves the reason: cos20° solves the irreducible cubic 8x³−6x−1, degree 3, and 3 divides no power of 2, so the value lives outside any line-circle program. You SEE the missing rung the compass reaches into and misses — not a sentence that says so. A brass NEUSIS toggle (a marked ruler) then lights a third tool: slide a two-tick ruler until both ticks seat — the classical verging move — and the trisection LANDS exactly; a rung grows at height 3, the bead seats, and the cartouche flips to CONSTRUCTED (with neusis). Founds the FIGURES YOU CONSTRUCT wing; its named-dark siblings are a Galois Cabinet, a double-the-cube origami bench, a Gauss–Wantzel regular-n-gon table, and a neusis/conics annex.

sorts.t: The secret is the cyan dashed line on its deck: the stone's mass axis, tilted a few degrees off its keel.
sorts.src: A canoe-shaped stone on green felt that argues with your hand. Flick it the favored way and it spins clean; flick it the WRONG way and the belly-rock GROWS as the spin bleeds to zero — then it spontaneously REVERSES into its favored spin and settles there. The secret is the cyan dashed line on its deck: the stone's mass axis, tilted a few degrees off its keel. That skew couples spin to rocking; spin one way and the rock is damped, the other and it is anti-damped, fed by the spin until the spin gives out and flips. Drag the skew angle δ to zero (or hit the diagonal-tensor button) and the line snaps to the keel — now it spins happily both ways, the negative control. The reversal is emergent from the integrator, never scripted: the verdict flips only because the integrated spin crossed zero, and a self-test proves both launches end at the single favored sign, the diagonal tensor spins both ways, and energy is conserved to machine ε on the frictionless run — the reversal is real spin↔rock energy transfer. Kin to the collision lane and the dissection bench: a thing you touch, with the mechanism made visible.

A governor dial finds the lock: too slow is a carousel of stills, too fast a smear, and reverse gallops it backward; a small warm bloom flares the instant it catches. Export your strip as an engraved contact sheet, or copy a compact reloadable seed and paste it back later. Deliberately claim-free — persistence-of-vision stays a whisper at the foot, never a proof; the aliasing wing owns that theorem. The wheel of life the Victorians turned by candlelight.

sorts.t: There is no vehicle: YOUR FINGERTIP is the parallel-transported vector.
sorts.src: Carry a gold spear around a loop on a court you can BEND — and it comes home pointing wrong. There is no vehicle: YOUR FINGERTIP is the parallel-transported vector. Pick the spear off the surveyor's geodesy net and drag any freehand path; at every micro-step the engine applies the curved metric's Levi-Civita connection, so the spear visibly rotates even though your hand never twisted it — a frozen slate ghost-north riding alongside keeps the gap legible. Close the loop and a brass protractor blooms with the leftover angle Δθ — and that leftover IS the curvature you enclosed, ∬K dA (Gauss-Bonnet, shown not stated). A knurled curvature dial bends K from sphere → flat → saddle and the mesh breathes; at the flat DETENT it clicks and the run goes boring on purpose — Δθ = 0 for any loop, navigation Euclidean. A figure-eight's opposite-sign lobes cancel to zero; two grains dragged north kiss on the dome and flee on the saddle. Founds CURVED COUNTRY; self-proved by a Node twin + an in-page pill; kin to the Planimeter (area from a boundary).
