It re-pins itself from the plan each cycle, so it never falls behind the estate.

sorts.t: Twelve prove a theorem exactly; one states the question mathematics cannot yet answer — and is honest about which is which.
sorts.src: The estate's number-theory wing — arithmetic made a place you can walk. Thirteen benches where the plain counting numbers turn out to have a shape: descend the Stern–Brocot tree to the best fraction, watch the primes line up on the diagonals of a spiral, trace the tree every number falls down to 1, draw a cardioid out of the times table, cut two rods down to the rod that measures them both, count a sunflower's spiral arms to read off two Fibonacci numbers, take stones from heaps where the XOR rule decides who wins, and slide a lone queen home where her safe squares trace two lines climbing at the golden ratio. Twelve prove a theorem exactly; one states the question mathematics cannot yet answer — and is honest about which is which.

sorts.t: Two engraved brass wellhead dials decide.
sorts.src: The estate's wing for the planet's own heat engine — ONE side-on geological survey plate, read from the smoking sky down through the ash crust, a glass-walled conduit, the magma chamber, the slow mantle, to an ember hint of the core. The whole wing is that one drawing: the landing (THE STANDING SECTION) frames the column entire; click the glowing conduit and the SAME plate dollies in until the glass walls fill the frame — a byte-identical depth ribbon imported by both pages is the proof it is one room, not two. Down in the conduit the live bench (THE SAME VENT, TWO TEMPERS) asks one question with two answers: does a rising melt reach the surface as a coherent LAVA OOZE, or does its trapped gas grow until the foam SHATTERS it into an explosive jet? Two engraved brass wellhead dials decide. SILICA stiffens the melt along a log-viscosity scale anchored to named rock arcs — basalt → andesite → dacite → rhyolite — recolouring it from deep-orange to straw-pink and visibly slowing the bubbles; DISSOLVED GAS fills the bubble field and lifts a visible exsolution horizon. As the pressure falls toward the vent, Henry's law (C_s = s·√P) exsolves the surplus volatile and the bubbles EXPAND, so the gas VOLUME fraction φ climbs toward the vent. A luminous shear band — the FRAGMENTATION PLANE at φ=¾ (the Sparks-1978 foam-disruption criterion) — slides continuously through the conduit as you turn the dials; push toward explosive and it descends from above the vent down into the column, and the instant it crosses the vent lip the coherent ooze UNZIPS into the jet. Press RELEASE THE VENT and the decompression run marches once, the bubble field blooming bottom-to-top as the wave climbs. The viscosity is the gate, not the gas alone: a runny basalt lets its bubbles rise out and degas, so even at MAXIMUM gas it stays effusive; only a stiff, gassy rhyolite locks the gas in and shatters. The sole physics authority is a self-tested DOM-free conduit core with a headless Node twin, forge-inlined byte-for-byte: over an N×N (silica,gas) dial grid the rendered column march === the analytic style-predicate with ZERO disagreements; on the EFFUSIVE↔EXPLOSIVE boundary φ_max = ¾ exactly and the fragmentation plane sits at the vent lip; the boundary is monotone in both dials; and the neg-controls hold — gas→0 fragments nothing, and basalt at full gas cannot blast. The EFFUSIVE/EXPLOSIVE word and the plane height z_f the page shows are read DIRECTLY from that predicate. Its named-dark benches are the Melting Floor (decompression melting at the chamber roof), Slow Creep (mantle rock that flows over geologic time), and the Shadow Zone (the seismic shadow the molten outer core casts). Kin to THE FOUNDRY next door — there an abstract potential settles to the one harmonic field its boundary allows; here the literal planet melts, rises, and shatters by a threshold on its own gas.

sorts.t: Where a dying star is weighed, not just watched.
sorts.src: Where a dying star is weighed, not just watched. Put a stellar core on the scales and drag the brass collar to add mass: past Chandrasekhar (≈1.44 M☉) the electron floor snaps and the luminous body IMPLODES into a spinning neutron star; past TOV (≈2.2–2.3 M☉) the neutron floor snaps too and the horizon irises shut into a black hole. The body itself is the readout — it cools, implodes, or disappears — never a curve you read off an axis. Two ordered gates ⇒ three fates, proved exact by classify(M) with an always-neutron neg-control that fails both flips. A companion fusion-ladder bench works the other end of a star's life: it builds the elements up to iron and refuses to climb further.

sorts.src: You cannot push a flock — you can only choose where your dog stands. A scatter of sheep run on the three Reynolds boids rules (keep apart, fly together, match the flock) and additionally FLEE one shepherd point: a working dog you steer, which has weight and a top speed and chases your cursor on a critically-damped spring. Drive every sheep through the gate into the brass fold before the glass runs out, across a three-round arc — an open pasture, a wall with a single gap to thread, and a detached cluster of strays to re-merge first. Underneath the game runs a quiet decidable conscience: a hard-floor separation barrier guarantees min pairwise sheep-separation NEVER reaches 0 (no two sheep ever overlap — proven by an unconditionally-stable positional projection that a per-step speed clamp forbids any sheep tunnelling past), and WIN latches EXACTLY iff every sheep is inside the fold polygon (a robust concave-safe point-in-polygon, no timer race, no close-enough). A live pill mirrors both claims; flip the Separation toggle OFF and the neg-control collapses the whole flock to a point on screen, the pill diving red — proving separation is what keeps them a herd. The same three rules, passive, breathe the murmuration in the Strange Garden's Boids; here you steer them into a pen.

sorts.t: A balance point you set the marble exactly upon never sways — to show the calm you must first nudge it a hair off.
A bar dropped as 'degenerate' was only ever waiting for the right four-bar; gather the scattered, correct the record.
A bearing is not a tone but the sound of air remembering the shape of the wood it turns in.
A bearing is only wood remembering the turn; I pitched the memory to the speed and let the slits keep time.
A bearing proves it is wood not by staying still, but by the way its whir climbs with the wheel.
A bed of only cross-links is a bed that forgot how to grow a flower. Pull the dry seeds; sow things you can touch.
A bed of only crossings is a bed of only mirrors; I planted seven things that move.
A bed runs dry not for want of seeds but for want of different seeds; I planted seven shapes, not seven copies.
A beetle is conspicuous only against the ground it was born onto; move the ground and you reveal who must die.
A bell earns its warmth by keeping its metal; the sweetest tone that forgets it was struck is only an organ.
A bell is judged not by how loud it strikes but by how cleanly its hum names the note.
A bell is only half the gift; the gold that wells up to catch it is the breath released.
A bell is warm when its metal speaks only at the strike and the ring forgets it was ever struck.

Above the line, the truth and its ghost are the same hand — only a cosine keeps the seam invisible.

Belief is a liquid: it pours between vessels but never spills past one.

Fifty-five march as one; kill them and the survivors only quicken. The wall you hide behind is the wall that erodes.
Five hands that share no joints reach for the same six; the wonder is not that one is right but that none can lie.
Frequencies lie when letters only move, not change — the rod hides in plain English.
